subject: Robot trust and hostname redirection survive a cold reboot
whyThisWasOpen: Trust was previously supplied by a bind mount over /etc/ssl/certs sourced from /opt. That mount is not in fstab, so it could not survive a reboot, and reboot readiness was explicitly unclaimed. repoint-robot.sh instead installs the CA into the real root-filesystem store underneath the bind.
testDesign: Before the reboot the CA existed ONLY in the masked real directory, not in the active bind store. A reboot therefore tested exactly the persistence claim: if the CA had been written through the bind, as the earlier manual setup did, the robot would return with no Phoenix CA at all.

before.mountOverSslCerts: /dev/mmcblk0p6 on /etc/ssl/certs type ext4 (bind, masking the real directory)
before.caInRealStore: phoenix-ca.crt present plus ad76badb.0 subject-hash symlink

after.mountOverSslCerts: none - the bind is gone and the real store is active
after.hostsBlock: managed block intact, both names resolve to 192.168.1.182
after.robotFetch: https://api.jibo.com/healthcheck 200 via 192.168.1.182, robot system trust, no -k
after.notificationLog: Connecting to api-socket.jibo.com:443/<token> then 'established connection to server'
after.timeToReconnect: about one minute after boot, on the first attempt

significance: Before this work the same service logged 50 consecutive connection failures. After a cold boot with no manual intervention it connected on the first attempt, through the persistent trust store and the persistent hosts block.
explicitlyNotVerified: Notification DELIVERY end to end. Only the WebSocket upgrade, its persistence and its recovery across a reboot.
Microphone, wake word and physical ring behavior.
Conversation after reboot: the hub still reaches Phoenix through the SSH reverse tunnel, which is not part of this persistence claim.
Any Classic operation beyond the notification token request.
ledgerEffect: None. A-10 remains todo and the checklist stays at 8/79. This closes the specific reboot-persistence question for robot trust and hostname redirection, not the parent task.
